records.issue_text: apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:81 performs a non-atomic credential lookup and creation, allowing concurrent webhook deliveries to create duplicate user/app credentials; subsequent findFirst updates affect only one record, potentially leaving stale tokens in the others.
records.rationale: The diff shows prisma.credential.findFirst followed by a separate create with no unique constraint handling or transaction; concurrent webhook calls can both pass the findFirst check and create duplicate credentials for the same userId/appId, as the code itself comments 'Can't use prisma upsert as we don't know the id'. This is a verifiable correctness defect introduced by this new handler.
